title: Multi-Level Randomized Saturation Trial of Universal Basic Rent in Spain: Labor Supply, Housing Pass-Through, and AI Disruption
lead_institution: Consorcio de Investigación en Renta Básica Universal (CIRBU)
consortium_partners: Centro de Estudios Monetarios y Financieros (CEMFI)
Institut Català d'Avaluació de Polítiques Públiques (Ivàlua)

hypotheses.statement: Unconditional cash transfers reduce weekly hours worked by <= 1.5 h/week, concentrated in voluntary overtime reductions among secondary earners, with zero net contraction in formal participation.
hypotheses.primary_register: TGSS MCVL (bases de cotización & coeficientes de parcialidad)
hypotheses.econometric_estimator: Continuous Spatial Spillover OLS with Wild Cluster Bootstrap

hypotheses.statement: In supply-inelastic clusters, rental pass-through on active 5-year LAU contracts is <= 5.0%, while turnover leases experience 25-35% pass-through, mitigated by the federal fiscal benchmark.
hypotheses.primary_register: Regional Rental Deposit Registries (INCASÒL, IVIMA, AVRA)

hypotheses.statement: Unconditional liquidity increases post-displacement search duration by 3-6 weeks, yielding 6-10% higher subsequent wage stability and higher self-employment survival.
UBR receipt improves standardized subjective wellbeing by >= +0.25 SD and reduces psychotropic medical prescription billing by >= 15%.
hypotheses.target_metric: GHQ-12 Mental Health Index & SNS Prescription Claims
hypotheses.primary_register: INSS Tier 1 Temporary Disability & Regional Health Services
hypotheses.econometric_estimator: ANCOVA with baseline adjustment and cluster clustering

hypotheses.statement: Life-cycle structural decomposition proves that >= 60% of observed non-employment in high AI-exposure CNO-11 occupations is attributable to structural labor demand rationing rather than voluntary leisure preferences.
hypotheses.primary_register: EPA Flow Data + Track 1 CNO-11 Exposure Crosswalk

primary_endpoints.name: Weekly Hours Worked
primary_endpoints.description: Effective weekly hours calculated from TGSS contract coefficient and daily affiliation records

primary_endpoints.name: Executed Transaction Rent
primary_endpoints.description: Executed lease rent in EUR/month for mandatory rental deposits linked by cadastral reference

primary_endpoints.name: Annual Taxable Labor Earnings
primary_endpoints.description: Gross earned income declared under AEAT Modelo 190 / Modelo 100

primary_endpoints.name: Temporary Incapacity Days
primary_endpoints.description: Cumulative days on medically certified sick leave (bajas IT) for stress or depression

primary_endpoints.name: Solo Self-Employment Entry
primary_endpoints.description: Net transitions into RETA (Régimen Especial de Trabajadores Autónomos)

econometric_equations.spatial_spillover_model: Y_{ic} = alpha + beta_1 * T_{ic} + beta_2 * Cash_c + gamma * sum_j W_{cj} Cash_j + X'_{ic} delta + eps_{ic}
econometric_equations.synthetic_diff_in_diff: tau_SDID = (Y_{post, treat} - sum_i omega_i Y_{post, i}) - sum_t lambda_t (Y_{t, treat} - sum_i omega_i Y_{ti})
econometric_equations.saez_chetty_convex_bunching: b = B / h_0(K) ; eps^c = (b * Delta_w) / (K * ln((1 - tau_1) / (1 - tau_2)))
econometric_equations.lifecycle_frisch_decomposition: Delta ln h = eps^Frisch Delta ln w^trans + eps^c Delta ln w^perm + eta [G_pilot / (A + H) * (1 - (1+r)^-T) / (1 - (1+r)^-(T_ret - t))] + zeta_rationing * P_disp + e

multiple_testing_corrections.fwer_primary_family: Bonferroni-Holm step-down procedure applied within primary outcome families (Labor, Housing, Health).
multiple_testing_corrections.fdr_exploratory_endpoints: Benjamini-Hochberg procedure with q = 0.05 applied across all exploratory secondary outcomes.
multiple_testing_corrections.cluster_inference: Wild Cluster Bootstrap (Rademacher 2-point weights) with 999 replications, complemented by Fisher Randomization Inference.

data_governance_and_privacy.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 salted hashing with master secret held exclusively by AEAT/INE statistical firewall.
data_governance_and_privacy.legal_basis: Art. 95.1.k Ley General Tributaria (LGT) and Ley Orgánica 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).
data_governance_and_privacy.access_tiering: Tier 1 centralized register access through INE secure data enclaves; Tier 2 regional health via Bilateral Convenios under Ley 16/2003.

finite_horizon_mitigations.step_down_ramp: 6-month post-pilot phase-out ramp (100% -> 66% -> 33% -> 0%) to prevent welfare cliffs and post-trial dislocation.
finite_horizon_mitigations.sabbatical_separation: Structural discount factor formula separates temporary 36-month leisure elasticity from permanent life-cycle labor supply.
